redfin.remarks: Prime Koreatown Covered Land Play & Value-Add Opportunity! Positioned within an official Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ), the property offers incoming investors substantial tax incentives and capital gains deferrals. Located in the highly desirable Wilshire Center/Koreatown submarket (90004), 148 S Normandie Ave is situated on a prime ±5,944 sq. ft. corner lot, perfectly pairing stable immediate cash flow with massive development upside. Operational flexibility with the current tenants are on Month-to-Month leases, delivering a frictionless path for a developer looking to break ground or a value-add buyer looking to immediately capture true market-rate stabilization. Owner overhead is kept low, as all units are individually metered for electricity and gas, strictly limiting utility exposure. Do not miss this secure, low-overhead wealth preservation vehicle in one of Los Angeles' most supply-constrained rental markets!
